pr_title: wip: API for projects and boards
pr_body:
Fixes #14299 

This is my first jab at anything in go lang, so please bear with me if you notice some mistakes for time being.

- [x] Swagger documentation for all the required endpoints.
- [x] Integration Test suites for all the endpoints.
- [x] Implementation's
pr_comments:
> I will work on the the test's and implementations once the API definition is ok, can anyone confirm if the api def is ok

@dineshsalunke just have a look at https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#api-v1

- List endpoint do miss page & limit support

the endpoints do look like they are similar to https://docs.github.com/en/rest/projects/projects#list-repository-projects - so that's ok
@6543 all the changes are done as per the swagger
@6543 any update on this ?
@dineshsalunke sorry for the delay :)

Awesome! Do you think it would be possible to add a way to assign a project to a board directly at its creation? (similarly to how label can be added at the creation of an issue) It would make scripting easier.
What is the plan for this PR? This is the main feature I had been waiting in 1.18

@f403 sorry I didn't get time to finish this up been busy with a lot of things, with the baby coming in etc..

I will finish this and push it asap

> Awesome! Do you think it would be possible to add a way to assign a project to a board directly at its creation? (similarly to how label can be added at the creation of an issue) It would make scripting easier.

i dont think that should be difficult let me check on that and get back
Do I understand correctly, this PR won't be merged in 1.19.0?

> Do I understand correctly, this PR won't be merged in 1.19.0?

Now it's in milestone 1.20

TODOs:
- [ ] Fix Tests
- [ ] Optional: handle org/individual projects
- [ ] make board api similar to github (/projects/{projectID}/columns) 
- [ ] merge "board" categorty into "project" category in swagger docs
- [ ] /projects/columns/{boardID}/cards for actuall issues/pulls list to return
This feature would be great so that we can import project boards from other tools (e.g. import tasks from Mattermost Focal Board)

i've taken it upon myself to bring this pr up to date with the base branch and fix some panics i encountered. attached is a patch file you can apply @dineshsalunke 

[gitea-projects-fixes.patch](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/files/12270442/gitea-projects-fixes.patch)
i ended up moving from the Project functionality to simply use the Issues to manage tasks
would love to see this released !
@6543 I have moved the methods into its own packages and also added new endpoints can you do a quick check on it and its ok then I will move forward with updating all the routes accordingly

Any progress? I can help you with writing tests or something. It's been a really old PR.
Edited: file a PR to https://github.com/dineshsalunke/gitea/pull/1 for the basic test
Is it okay to close this one and reopen the same one? The commit history is too long and mixed with some other information.

I would be more than happy feel free to add things as you feel.

honestly, I was thinking of the same thing its just that I didn't wanted history to repeat itself :D so I am thinking of working on finishing up the major stuff in here itself and then once we are in good position then we can close this and raise a new PR.
